name: git-sqlite-vfs
description: A Git-Versioned SQLite Database via a Custom Virtual File System (VFS)

scripts.pretest: npm run build && rm -rf .db test.db .test-db .compaction-db .git && git init --initial-branch=master
scripts.test:deno: npm run build && rm -rf .db test.db .test-db .git && git init --initial-branch=master && deno test -A test.deno.ts
